title: Set SubDevice State
text: Set state of EtherCAT network, 2 inputs, 2 outputs; {Network Device Index} sets the etherCAT network identifier, {SubDevice Name} sets the name of EtherCAT subordinate device character and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: New State
ports.summary: State transmitted to the EtherCAT network 1 | 2 | 4 | 8

ports.name: Enable
ports.summary: Enables block to send state request 0 | 1

ports.name: Prev State
ports.summary: Previous state of the selected device 1 | 2 | 4 | 8

ports.name: Error
ports.summary: Report an EtherCAT state error 0 | integer

params.name: SubDevice Name
params.values: Name of EtherCAT subordinate device character vector
